class_evidence: 20 datasets (Table 2, p7): real-world from Chawla et al. 2002, LIBSVM, the KDD'99 Intrusion subset and biological sets, plus UCI (Sec 5.3, pp7-8). All used as two-class problems with one minority percentage each (Table 2); Intrusion keeps u2r vs normal (Sec 5.3, p8). Motivating experiments use artificial two-class radial data (Sec 2, Fig 2-3, Table 1, pp2-4); Pima is the worked example (Fig 4, p6).
reduced_multiclass: Multiclass UCI sources reduced to smallest class vs the rest; Letter uses vowels vs consonants (Sec 5.3, p8). Which datasets were converted is not stated.
smote_explanation: LS leaves the SMOTE generator unchanged but applies it per segment: a Hellinger-distance tree of height at most 2 splits the training data into up to 4 segments (Alg 1, Sec 3, pp4-5), and a 5-fold CV wrapper searches each segment for its own undersampling level (0-100%) and SMOTE level (0-500%) (Alg 2, Sec 4, p5). The number of synthetic points per seed therefore varies by segment, and generation runs inside a wrapper search rather than once before training. Seeds, partner and placement inside a segment are as in SMOTE.
flags: SMOTE runs per segment (Alg 2 line 3, p5), which implies partners come from the same segment (a Neighbour choice change) but the paper does not say so. LS is a general framework; only SMOTE plus undersampling is tested.

class_evidence: Studies only the two-class case (Sec 1, p475). Two UCI datasets (Table 3, p480): Satimage (6,435; 626 positive) and Haberman (306; 81 positive). k=5, 10-fold CV, C4.5, Naive Bayes and SVM (Sec 4, p480).
reduced_multiclass: Satimage: class 4 vs all other classes merged (Sec 4, p480).
smote_explanation: Each minority point has a safe level, the number of minority points among its k nearest neighbours (Eq 7, p478), and the ratio of the seed's and partner's safe levels bounds the gap (Fig 1, Sec 3, pp478-479): ratio 1 gives U(0,1) as in SMOTE, above 1 pulls the point towards the seed, below 1 towards the partner. When the partner's safe level is 0 the seed is copied, and when both are 0 nothing is generated, so noise pairs are skipped. The partner is still drawn uniformly from the 5 nearest minority neighbours and nothing is removed afterwards.
corrections: Add Seed selection: generation is skipped when seed and sampled partner both have safe level 0 (Fig 1 lines 12-14, p479). Cases with partner safe level 0 produce copies of the seed, not interpolated points.
flags: Fig 1 searches neighbours in the positive set but Eq 7 counts positives among neighbours, which implies a whole-data neighbourhood; the skip depends on the random partner as well as the seed.
